dedup: Compared old identifiers and arXiv aliases, normalized titles and related report versions. Screened first-author and similar-title matches; prior text mentions also treated conservatively as historical. Historical means present in the curated material or prior notes/logs, not an unscreened API hit in a raw search archive. Data DOI and paper DOI treated as distinct resource types.
similar_title_review: An improved instrumental variable method for industrial robot model identification
An automated instrumental variable method for rigid industrial robot identification
similar_title_disposition: The only near-title pair was improved IV versus automated IV, distinct registry records with different titles and articles. Both already appear in older G1 catalogues.
family_handling: OpenMCT data article explicitly cites the companion HardwareX kit description in reference [1]. Both concern the same OpenMCT setup. The kit paper does not cite the later data paper in its deposited references or full-text reference list. They are two publications and do not establish two independently collected datasets.
The ultrasonic-motor paper and English republication are grouped.
The 2024 simulated and 2025 physical experiment stages of optimal reference voltage saturation are attached to the journal row; the TechRxiv variants are aliases.
Dyrac preprint v1 used the older title Design and Characterization of the Dynamic Robotic Actuator Dyrac.
Benchmark report v2 and its v1 URN are one work. Data DOI 10.26204/data/5 is not the report identifier.
Multiple papers use the same model of industrial robot, including Stäubli TX40; a bibliography count is not an independent experiment count.
limitations: Targeted discovery, not systematic coverage. Hardware metrics require published experimental evidence and are specific to the plant and excitation. Only links, factual notes and response hashes are redistributed.
